acceptance.given: An external process is executing through the bounded replay path.

oracle.expected: The execution reaches a deterministic terminal state; budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.
forbidden: The external process ends in an indeterminate or nondeterministic terminal state.
oracle.observable: The bounded process result identifies one deterministic terminal state for the external process.

acceptance.then: The external process is in a deterministic terminal state.
acceptance.when: The S35 selector observes termination of an external process execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S35 process-execution test with a bounded execution that cannot establish a deterministic terminal result; it must fail rather than report success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify every bounded external process completion as a deterministic terminal state and treat budget exhaustion as unsuccessful.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema migration; rollback restores prior process-execution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: External process executing -> deterministic terminal state, with exhaustion classified as unsuccessful.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S35 selector identifies one deterministic terminal state for each bounded process execution and does not accept exhaustion as successful.

acceptance.given: The six frozen Matrix Cases and independently identifiable Stable and Candidate subjects are prepared for replay-matrix evaluation.

oracle.expected: Every Matrix Case has separate execution records for both Stable and Candidate subjects, and the aggregate fails for any missing execution.
forbidden: A Matrix Case executes only one subject.
A Matrix Case does not execute either subject.
oracle.observable: Replay-matrix execution records enumerate both subject executions for each of the six Matrix Cases.

acceptance.then: Every Matrix Case has execution coverage for both subjects.
acceptance.when: The S41 replay-matrix selector runs the six Matrix Cases.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S41 matrix test with one Matrix Case missing either Stable or Candidate execution; aggregate validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each of the six Matrix Cases to execute both Stable and Candidate subjects and reject the aggregate if either execution is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema migration; rollback restores prior matrix-execution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix evaluation without established two-subject coverage -> all six Matrix Cases have Stable and Candidate execution records.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S41 selector verifies both subject executions in all six Matrix Cases and rejects any missing execution.

acceptance.given: Frozen historical tracked membership and the pre-repair byte identities are available as comparison inputs.

oracle.expected: The comparison reports that every protected existing byte is unchanged.
forbidden: Treating appended repair evidence as a rewrite of historical bytes.
oracle.observable: The historical-byte comparison result produced during the FR-5 preservation check.

acceptance.then: Existing bytes remain unchanged and any repair evidence is append-only.
acceptance.when: The historical preservation check compares the frozen baseline with the repair candidate.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise the historical-byte comparison with a changed protected byte and require the preservation check to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve and verify protected historical byte identities during repair without rewriting the frozen source set.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Historical tracked membership, repository-relative paths, and protected bytes remain compatible and unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen existing bytes -> byte-level preservation verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The preservation check establishes unchanged protected bytes; any protected-byte difference is rejected.

acceptance.given: The current declared Consumer Manifest and the repository call surface are available for reconciliation.

oracle.expected: The frozen result contains a complete Consumer Manifest whose entries and repository callers reconcile in both directions, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers.
forbidden: A caller present in the repository call surface but absent from the Consumer Manifest.
A manifest entry without a corresponding repository caller.
Omitting VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing from reconciliation.
oracle.observable: The Consumer Manifest reconciliation result emitted by the shared replay toolchain path.

acceptance.then: The complete current Consumer Manifest is bidirectionally reconciled with all required repository callers.
acceptance.when: Consumer Manifest reconciliation scans declared consumers and the repository real-call surface before the manifest is frozen.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the FR-9 reconciliation test with an omitted VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller and observe the expected rejecting failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Build the complete current Consumer Manifest from declared consumers and the repository call-surface scan, then reject either direction of any mismatch, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Consumer Manifest entries remain version-bound and reconciliation preserves required VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing coverage.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unreconciled declared and discovered consumer sets -> frozen bidirectionally reconciled Consumer Manifest.
